title: Preregistered cross-environment computational reproduction of WitnessCell v14
description: A confirmatory CPU-only reproduction of 12 frozen WitnessCell v14 split outputs, evidence-gate branches and paired mean-response metrics, plus an integrity audit of the explicitly inherited Gate18 benchmark aggregation. No new biological data are collected and no new v14 raw-h5ad six-metric scoring is claimed.
